# RGB Curves

Remaps scene colours through combined and per-channel curves.

`lfs.rgb_curves` · Colour

## How to use

Use Selection and Factor to blend the result.\
This nonlinear adjustment changes only the DC colour of splats and preserves view-dependent SH bands.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Splats, points or mesh vertices to colour. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Per-element blend weight from 0 to 1. |
| Factor | `Factor` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Additional curve effect strength from 0 to 1. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry with remapped colours. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Combined | `combined` | data | [[0, 0], [1, 1]] | — | Curve applied to every channel first. |
| Red | `r` | data | [[0, 0], [1, 1]] | — | Curve applied to red. |
| Green | `g` | data | [[0, 0], [1, 1]] | — | Curve applied to green. |
| Blue | `b` | data | [[0, 0], [1, 1]] | — | Curve applied to blue. |
